prompt:
Persistent Hotcell cells created before the `.12` runtime rollout fail with `cell_prompt_rejected` because the cell runtime tries to upgrade them by fetching an unpublished prerelease from npm. Change `src/server/aster-cell-runtime.ts` so a pre-existing cell is upgraded from the SDK bundled with the server: transfer the SDK in bounded chunks, stop the old idle bridge, and update the cell's version marker only after a successful refresh. No `npm install` must run in the cell for this path.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/server/aster-cell-runtime.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/server/aster-cell-runtime.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
